sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No supplied candidate verifies the required greatest-displacement UIWL selection or provides per-waterline displacement coverage; selecting an existing displacement term would not resolve the reported cross-owner semantics.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the UIWL selection and required-path coverage. Add a ship-level hasUpperIceWaterline constraint with minCount 1, and a node shape for each iceWaterline requiring waterlineDisplacement as a decimal quantity in TON_Metric. Ensure displacementAtUpperIceWaterline equals the waterlineDisplacement of the selected UIWL and that no other UIWL has a greater displacement; the current FILTER only rejects a selected value below another value and therefore permits a displacement greater than every UIWL.
